text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Stargrove Diagnostics asked for a temporary EU egress allowlist + QPS bump for a customer-facing demo tomorrow. They said demo success affects renewal conversation. @alex_netops can you confirm what we can provision quickly?

alex_netops: Can you paste exact IPs and the time window? Also what's the expected sustained QPS and burst?

maria_cs: IPs they gave: 
```
203.0.113.45/32
198.51.100.0/24
```
Window: 2026-03-26 08:00-12:00 UTC. Target: 150 QPS sustained, bursts up to 300. Customer asked for auto-revoke after demo.

alex_netops: 198.51.100.0/24 is pretty wide — prefer they narrow to /28 or a few /32s. I can provision eu-edge allowlist + temp QPS increase, but need a ticket and an owner for rollback. Will also set alerts.

sam_support: Created ticket INF-4571 and attached the CIDRs and demo window. Linking here: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-4571. Owner set to @alex_netops for netops steps.

jen_prod: Recommend rollout plan: allowlist rule -> set qps=150, enable burst capacity to 300 -> monitor 15m for latency/regressions -> auto-revoke 12:15 UTC. Also enable prefix caching for that customer during demo. If latency >200ms or error rate spikes, rollback to baseline.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: allowlist rule created: rule-9321, scope=eu-edge, auto_revoke=2026-03-26T12:15:00Z, ticket=INF-4571 :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: Thanks all. I’ll ask customer to tighten the CIDR to a /28 or provide explicit /32s ASAP. Also flagging renewal risk on the account — they said if demo fails because of infra limits they may accelerate decision to Dedicated.

alex_netops: I'll provision the QPS change: qps=150, burst=300. Setting alert at 80% capacity and paging eng-oncall if crossed. Will document fallback to gcp-eu region if eu-edge saturates.

sam_support: Customer notified and calendar updated with confirmed window + post-demo feedback checkpoint. CSM to capture output and share telemetry.

maria_cs: I'll follow up with the customer for CIDR tightening and add the renewal note in Gainsight. Thanks team :thumbsup:
